title: Carved Heraldic Relief
purpose: Identity and provenance surfaces; brand crest accent.
story: A carved stone crest in deep relief — the wordless emblem of an institution, hewn into permanence and grazed by one light.
environment: A close view of a carved stone panel, the heraldic relief lit raking from one side, the wall beyond in shadow.
architecture: Implied only — a monumental wall face suggested behind the carved panel.
composition: The relief filling the frame slightly off-centre, raking light deepening every cut shadow, the surround falling into negative space.
materials: a faint brass patina in the hollows
negativeExtra: any letters or words in the carving
continuityNotes: Echoes scene-30's brass-on-black palette with one warm raking source; the crest carries purely abstract forms, no letters or words.
